title: Heuristic VPC prober for throughput & degradation detection
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: build a lightweight, environment-agnostic prober and SLO signal derivation pipeline for Private (VPC) deployments that detects throughput degradation, token-saturation events, latency regressions, and correlated error-rate spikes. This prober will run as an optional sidecar/DaemonSet (Terraform module) so it can be deployed alongside customer private workers without changing runtime images. The output is structured metrics and events (token_rate, queue_length, inferred_saturation, latency_p50/p95/p99, error_rate) and a derived 'degradation_score' that feeds our SLO engine and alerting rules.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Terraform module deploys prober as helm chart/DaemonSet in customer's VPC and exposes metrics to the existing prometheus remote write setup. 2) Degradation score computed by combining EWMA token_rate drop + latency increase + error-rate delta documented and visible in Console. 3) Alert rules (warning/critical) generate playbook actions: warning -> notify and ingest targeted traces; critical -> initiate autoscale request or trigger capacity-fallback policy. 4) Canary rollout exercised on 2 internal private customers with no false-positive rate >3% over 48h test window.
implementation_notes: Design decisions: use multi-window EWMA for smoothing short bursts and retaining sensitivity to multi-minute trends; compute token throughput both as incoming tokens/sec and successful output tokens/sec to detect internal queueing vs external demand drops. Saturation heuristic combines queue_depth_ratio, token_service_time_ewma, and CUDA kernel retry/drop counters (where available). We'll rely on existing telemetry exporters where possible and add a small local exporter to capture queue depths and token-level counts.
infra_plan:
- new Terraform module: redwood/vpc-prober-module (variables: target_namespace, scrapes_enabled, prometheus_remote_write_endpoint)
- helm chart for prober and sidecar injector (opt-in)
- RBAC roles scoped to prober metrics only
- integration tests in infra-ci to deploy to staging VPC cluster and validate remote-write ingestion
observability_and_slos: Metrics emitted: prober_token_in_rate, prober_token_out_rate, prober_queue_length, prober_latency_p50/p95/p99, prober_error_rate, prober_degradation_score. Derived SLOs: availability (error_rate-based), latency (p95), throughput (tokens/sec baseline). Console dashboard: per-cluster and per-tenant views, with a single 'degradation' timeline for quick triage.
runbook_and_playbooks: Warning: degradation_score > 0.6 for 5m -> notify SRE + attach recent traces and top-10 slow endpoints. Critical: degradation_score > 0.85 for 2m -> scale up reserved pool (if dedicated) or promote region fallback, and mark route as degraded in routing mesh. Playbook links: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Prober+Playbook (internal), incident-runbook PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playbooks/pull/145
testing_notes: Test harness: synthetic token generator to exercise various token-size distributions and client-side pacing. Scenarios: bursty traffic, steady high-throughput, slow-client-induced queueing, and partial GPU degradation. Validation: scoreboard of false positives/negatives vs annotated ground truth over 72h. Load test PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-tests/pull/216
progress_updates: 2026-02-15: Kickoff sync with SRE, Infra, and Console teams. Aligned on metric names and remote-write contract.
2026-02-22: Prototype prober implemented (Go) that calculates EWMA windows and emits Prometheus metrics. Local tests show it detects synthetic queueing within 30s.
2026-03-01: Terraform module scaffolded; helm chart initial commit. Opened infra PR for staging deploy (PR #214).
2026-03-07: Design review with PM and Security. Feedback: lock down RBAC, make remote-write creds optional, and add an opt-out flag for PII telemetry. Actioned and updated module variables.

2026-03-13: Began canary deploy to internal-private-1 cluster. Observed a steady-state token_rate skew due to client pacing—adjusted degradation_score weights to reduce false-positive rate. Added follow-up task to calibrate thresholds per-customer (ENG-99299).
Next steps: finish enterprise canary on two internal private customers, add automated remediation hooks, and ship the terraform module to registry.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: prober adds CPU overhead on constrained private workers. Mitigation: resource limits set by default and sampling rate reduced; prober runs at 1/10th sampling by default and supports burst-sampling. Risk: false positives cause unnecessary scale events. Mitigation: multi-signal fusion and staged alerting (warning -> critical) with automated rollback capability.
review_feedback: PM Priya Singh: prefer per-tenant calibration knobs rather than global thresholds. Marking as follow-up.
SRE Jonah Park: ensure prober metrics are time-synced (NTP) and tolerant of clock skew when computing EWMAs. Also requested a hard kill switch via tf var.
